description: This file contains helper functions and tests for encoding conversions, specifically related to UTF-16 and UTF-32 encoding detection and writing, utilizing command-line tools like 'iconv' and 'printf'.

methods.name: write_utf16
methods.description: Outputs the UTF-16 byte order mark (BOM) if the prerequisite test passes, then converts input from UTF-8 to UTF-16 encoding.

methods.name: write_utf32
methods.description: Outputs the UTF-32 byte order mark (BOM) if the prerequisite test passes, then converts input from UTF-8 to UTF-32 encoding.
